caption: Three buttons built in code, each with width 0 and weight 1, share a 360 dp row, so each takes 120 dp of space (360 px at density 3). Tapping the second button hands the listener a View whose id is 101, so the index is 101 − 100 = 1.

spec.title: Three weight-1 buttons on a 360 dp row
spec.aria: A row of three buttons on a 360 dp screen: ids 100, 101 and 102, each 120 dp wide which is 360 px at density 3, with the middle button tapped so the listener receives id 101 at index 1.
